heading: Sunday
text: Morning showers mixing with snow over higher terrain, becoming more scattered in the afternoon with some breaks of sun. Cooler. Highs in the 40s to near 50 in the northeast, in the 50s elsewhere. Northwest wind near 10 mph.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly cloudy, with rain showers developing overnight. Wintry mix possible over higher terrain. Much colder. Lows in the 30s, near 30 over the higher terrain. Light and variable wind.

heading: Monday
text: Mostly cloudy, with numerous rain showers, becoming scattered in the south, remaining steady in the north and over the mountains. Highs in the 40s to near 50 north, increasing into the mid-50s south.
